meaning: This line ties the outlets of Rivp, Revp and Ro_spine to the inlet of Razy at one shared node, so internal vertebral, epidural and spinal outflow merge into a single azygos path with one common pressure. Editing who joins this junction changes venous topology, not just a parameter.

could_move.what: Any quantity downstream of the azygos path in model m6, since the three upstream branches share this node pressure and their flows sum into Razy
The jugular-compression comparison, which contrasts m5 and m6 venous routing; a topology edit shifts the m6 side of that contrast
The single entry point that builds and solves this model

expectation: Unknown. Direction and size depend on which branch is added or removed and on the resistances involved; the context gives no values.

check.why: Single-model solve through the only entry point for m6; confirms the system still assembles and lets outputs be compared, cheaper than a full re-fit.
